I've built the Team page, but I couldn't run any checks: the shell denied `tsc`, `eslint`, `npm run lint` and the test runner. So none of the code below has been compiled, linted or tested. I checked the types and lint rules by reading the library declarations, and matched the test assertions to the renderer source, but that is no substitute for running:

```
npx tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit
npm run lint
npm test
npm run migrate:test && npm run test:integration
```

**Files created**
- `src/app/team/team.routes.ts`
- `src/app/team/team.schema.ts`
- `src/app/team/team.store.ts`
- `src/app/team/team.service.ts`
- `src/app/team/team.view.ts`
- `src/app/team/team.controller.ts`
- `tests/unit/team-service.test.ts`
- `tests/view/team.view.test.ts`
- `tests/integration/team.test.ts`

**Files changed**
- `src/core/server/server.ts`: registers the new Team controller.
- `src/core/layout/layout.view.ts`: adds the "Team" link to the main navigation, shown to signed-in users only.
- `tests/unit/render-stance.test.ts`: adds the new routes and the search fragment to the contract test, which requires every fragment route to be listed.
- `tests/view/layout.test.ts`: checks the nav link shows only when signed in.
- `README.md`: one line in the feature list.

**How it behaves**
- **Styling:** the other app views are deliberately unstyled until the design pass. I followed that, so only the status badge is styled: green for Active, amber for Invited.
- **Search:** typing replaces only the searc
